p9_b3.ocr: The MAPSEsum serves as a crucial indicator of the models' overall performance, highlighting the percentage deviation of predicted values from actual observations, thereby allowing for a straightforward interpretation of forecasting accuracy. Conversely, the CAMMFS provides insights into the models' effectiveness over time, evaluating their ability to consistently deliver reliable forecasts on a monthly basis.

p9_b4.ocr: By analyzing these metrics, stakeholders can discern the relative strengths and weaknesses of each model, facilitating informed decisions regarding their application in real-world scenarios. Furthermore, the inclusion of additional parameters, such as the Last Week Forecast Score (LWFS), enhances the robustness of this comparative analysis, offering a multidimensional view of predictive capabilities. This data-driven approach underscores the importance of tailored modeling strategies in achieving optimal forecasting outcomes in complex environments.
